SEAT RE | status: DONE
did: Closed the T22 discrepancy. It is not a bug - the two builds lay the component list out differently, and the PC side is self-consistent.
evidence: PC Entity component add 0x00504F60 (Hex-Rays, this session): capacity = *(u32*)(this+100) and 0x3FFF (+0x64, low 14 bits); count = *(u16*)(this+102) (+0x66), tested 'count+1 > capacity', grown via sub_A09AB0(this+96,...) (+0x60 array), then *(_WORD*)(this+102) = count+1. PC Entity::GetComponentByType 0x005200C0 uses the same pair: *(this+96) base, *(u16*)(this+102) count. Writer and reader agree.
=> C1 STANDS for the PC build. The mod's +0x66 is correct. Do not change it. T1 is closed as not-a-bug.
PS3 reads the count at +0x64 in two independent functions (0x6a3e68: addi r29,r29,0x60 / lhz r0,4(r29) / lwz r9,0(r29) / slwi r0,r0,2; 0x6a2bd0: lwzu r0,0x60(r31) / lhz r4,4(r31)). So PS3 gold and PC 1.05 differ in this struct.
NEW RULE recorded in ops/RE-PS3-MAP.md section 2: any offset taken from the PS3 ELF is a hypothesis for the PC build until re-confirmed on the PC side.
Also updated ops/TASKBOARD.md: T1 closed (not a bug), T3 superseded by T13/C21, T9 moot (store removed), T12 done (C20), T20 done, added T21 (done), T22 (done), T23 ship-the-faction-test queued for IMPL, T24 name the faction-chain PS3 twin queued for RE.
negative result: the lwz rX,0xE8(r3) fingerprint for the PS3 twin of sub_6F5F70 returns ZERO hits across all 33,105,920 bytes of .text, so the PC body's null checks are not in the PS3 one. T24 says scan .map functions <=0x40 instead.
